result:
All 1584 tests pass. Note: running `pytest` in this environment requires `PYTHONPATH="$(pwd)/src"` — a globally-installed `click` package (pulled in as a dependency by several other tools) otherwise shadows the repo's own `src/click`, silently testing the wrong code.

**Change:** `MaybeStripAnsi` (used by `get_pager_file`/`echo_via_pager` to wrap the pager's output stream) now overrides `__del__` to `detach()` instead of relying on the default `close()`, matching the pattern `_NonClosingTextIOWrapper` already uses for the same reason. Without it, when this wrapper is garbage collected it would flush/close the stream it wraps — which for the null-pager fallback is a borrowed `stdout`, and for the pipe/tempfile pagers is a buffer already owned and closed elsewhere — risking an "I/O operation on closed file" error. Also added a `CHANGES.rst` entry.
